title: Maximum Subarray Sum
statement:
Given an array of n integers, print the largest possible sum of a non-empty contiguous subarray.

Input: the first line has n (1 <= n <= 5*10^4). The second line has n integers a_i (-10^9 <= a_i <= 10^9).

Output: a single integer.
reference_solution:
import sys
def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    best = cur = int(data[1])
    for x in map(int, data[2:n + 1]):
        cur = max(x, cur + x)
        best = max(best, cur)
    print(best)
main()
